title: Polarized cylinders on blow-ups of weighted projective planes
summary: We study polarized cylinders in certain rational surfaces arising from blow-ups of weighted projective planes. In particular, we consider the surfaces obtained by blowing up $m+4$ points in general position on the weighted projective plane $\mathbb{P}(1,1,m)$. These surfaces appear naturally as weighted hypersurfaces or quasi-smooth complete intersections.
